title: Index: Integrations
summary: Use records from manuals, missions, terminals, scans, and discoveries as one search surface.

blocks.title: Connected Systems
blocks.body: Wiki guide books appear in Index when available. Other addons can add their machines, items, routes, and tutorial records as searchable references.

blocks.title: Practical Pairings
blocks.body: Use Index records from Wiki guide books, Terminal recipe tabs, Industrial Nexus machines, PowerGrid parts, and Logistics supply planning.

blocks.title: Fallback Play
blocks.body: When a provider is missing, search the Wiki manual or local records directly. Index should speed up discovery, not be the only path to it.

blocks.title: Fallback Check
blocks.body: If the helper addon is absent, keep the same order by hand and follow the manual checkpoint.
